results.title: Cohort 17 Spotlight: Stacklist Helps You Save and Share Everything That Matters
results.content:
After a frustrating experience with contractors, Hudson found his co-founder, Martina Zrnec, through Gun.io. She quickly came on board and has since overseen all the code and development. Stacklist has been growing quickly since its public launch in September 2024, reaching 12,000 users. [...] Realizing he could learn more on his own than at college, he started selling web hosting and then founded his own web design and development agency. This began a “yin-yang” cycle of working at big agencies for a few years, getting frustrated with management, leaving, and starting his own agency again to collect new experiences. Over the years, his roles evolved from project manager to program manager and eventually to product manager, where he worked on projects for major clients like Marriott, Coke, and Spotify.

results.content:
Stacklist is a social bookmarking platform designed to help users easily save, organize, and share their favorite things. Whether it’s links, products, places, or experiences, Stacklist empowers individuals to curate meaningful collections—called Stacks—and share them with friends, followers, or collaborators. With powerful tools for saving and recalling co ntent, users can streamline their digital lives and eliminate clutter. Our platform also fosters discovery, enabling users to explore recommendations curated by people they trust. Stacklist offers a free plan with robust features, while our Curator Pro subscription unlocks advanced capabilities like customizable profiles, shortlinks, and collaboration tools.
